research_question: Can Trigger-1 semantic specificity remain promotion-eligible when semantic-target x output-code balance and interaction testing are only candidate-declared summary metadata rather than reconstructed from evidence-bearing executed cases?

material_finding.statement: No. A promotion boundary must reconstruct the exact 3x3 semantic-target x output-code design from per-case identities and six-control runtime-receipt digests, reject missing/unequal cells and lying summaries, and bind the holdout interaction-analysis receipt to the exact reconstructed holdout case universe.
material_finding.scope_boundary: This finding hardens evidence authenticity only. It does not validate the scientific interaction result and creates no model/runtime/semantic/HCU/training/whole-product credit.

implemented.coverage: Valid 3x3 positive fixture plus lying single-target summary, missing cell, unequal counts, missing control receipt, tampered factorial receipt, wrong interaction binding, duplicate case ID, and declared-count disagreement.

counterhypothesis.reason: The adjudicator consumes a candidate as evidence and must therefore fail closed when the candidate summary is not cryptographically/evidentially bound to executed case identities. Producer trust is not a substitute for recomputation at this boundary.
